projects.name: NetKnight
projects.tagline: A local-first household cybersecurity gateway where AI can propose actions but never authorize them.
projects.summary: NetKnight is a local-first household security platform. A Rust data plane forwards packets deterministically, without depending on any AI. Two unprivileged Python services — Sentinel for detection and Oracle for investigation — can only propose actions. A Rust policy engine alone authorizes typed, leased, verified and reversible actions, which narrow adapters execute and roll back.
highlights: Protobuf wire contracts with generated Rust, Python and TypeScript clients, checked by a cross-language compatibility matrix against a frozen baseline
Development security gate: secret scanning, OSV dependency audit and a license inventory that fails closed when offline
Reproducible setup with exact toolchain pins, verified on Windows and Linux in CI
Every design choice recorded as an Architecture Decision Record; every task closes with validation evidence

projects.name: PAIOS
projects.tagline: A local-first personal AI operating system that keeps your knowledge and models on your own hardware.
projects.summary: PAIOS (Personal AI Operating System) is a local-first platform for a private AI assistant. Its backend builds a privacy-first Knowledge Kernel — an authoritative catalog, encrypted sources, custom indexes and a local model — and a separate Next.js Control Plane lets the user inspect and manage the local stack.
highlights: Strictly sequential, numbered engineering tasks, each with an approved plan, validation and a focused commit
Control Plane browser app for knowledge search, provenance history, graph inspection and confirmed maintenance controls
Private Knowledge Kernel that keeps sources, indexes and the model on user-controlled hardware
